summary_en: Interim dividend of ¥11.00/share (¥10.00 ordinary + ¥1.00 special anniversary), total ¥87.16M, effective Sept 4, 2026. Increase of ¥1.00/share from forecast of ¥10.00. Celebration of 75th anniversary. Full-year FY2026 dividend projected at ¥22.00/share (¥20.00 ordinary + ¥2.00 anniversary).
title_en: Notice regarding dividend of surplus (special anniversary dividend)
translation_en_brief: On July 31, 2026, Takahashi Curtain Wall Corporation's Board of Directors approved an interim dividend with record date June 30, 2026. The dividend is set at ¥11.00 per share, comprising ¥10.00 ordinary dividend and ¥1.00 special anniversary dividend, for a total payout of ¥87.16M. This represents a ¥1.00 increase from the previously forecasted interim dividend of ¥10.00 per share. The increase is motivated by the company's 75th anniversary and is in line with the company's policy of achieving stable dividend returns to shareholders while maintaining internal reserves for future growth investments and business expansion. The dividend becomes effective on September 4, 2026. For full-year FY2026, the company projects a total dividend of ¥22.00 per share (¥20.00 ordinary + ¥2.00 anniversary).
